_comment: AttendanceTracker Settings - Edit these values to customize the application
_camera_note: Use 0 for default webcam, 1 for external camera, or full URL for IP camera (e.g., 'rtsp://192.168.1.100:554/stream')
_flip_note: Set to 1 to flip camera horizontally (mirror mode), 0 for normal
_capture_note: Number of frames to capture for stable face detection (higher = more stable but slower)
_skip_note: Skip frames in live feed to reduce lag (higher = less CPU usage but less responsive)
_drive_note: Google Drive folder URL containing student zip files. Folder must be publicly accessible.
_confidence_note: Face recognition confidence threshold (0.0-1.0). Higher = stricter matching. Recommended: 0.4-0.6
_min_face_note: Minimum face size in pixels to detect. Lower = detect smaller faces but slower.
_mtcnn_note: Advanced MTCNN detector settings. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
_mark_note: Symbol used to mark attendance in Excel file. Can be any text (e.g., 'P', 'X', '✓')
_dirs_note: Directory paths for storing data. Relative to application location.
